items: In which year did the Mongols sack Baghdad and end the Abbasid caliphate?
Which battle was the first major defeat of the Mongols by the Mamluks?
The Mamluks defeated the Mongols at Ain Jalut in 1260.
Which state is regarded as the first Turkic state to accept Islam?
The Karakhanids under Satuq Bughra Khan are regarded as the first.
In which year was the Battle of Manzikert?
Alp Arslan defeated the Byzantines at Manzikert in 1071.
Which Seljuk sultan won at Manzikert?
Alp Arslan captured the Byzantine emperor Romanos Diogenes.
What are the schools founded by the Seljuk vizier Nizam al-Mulk called?
He founded the Nizamiyyah madrasas in Baghdad and many other cities.
What was the capital of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum?
History of the Seljuks of Rum
Rumi wrote the Mathnawi in Konya.
In which year is the Ottoman state traditionally said to have been founded?
Osman Gazi is traditionally credited with founding it in 1299.
Which Ottoman sultan conquered Constantinople in 1453?
Mehmed II took Constantinople on 29 May 1453.
What was the Ottoman capital before the conquest of Istanbul?
Which country did Selim I conquer in 1517, ending the Mamluk state?
After the Battle of Ridaniyya Selim I annexed Egypt in 1517 and the Mamluk state came to an end.
Which battle under Suleiman the Magnificent added most of Hungary to the Ottomans?
The Battle of Mohacs (1526) defeated the Hungarian army.
Which commander won the naval battle of Preveza?
Barbarossa Hayreddin won at Preveza in 1538.
Which architect built the Suleymaniye Mosque?
Suleymaniye is regarded as Sinan's journeyman work.
Which mosque did Sinan call his masterpiece?
He described the Selimiye in Edirne as his masterpiece.
Ibn Battuta recorded his travels in the Rihla.
Which Timurid ruler built an observatory in Samarkand?
Ulugh Beg built the observatory at Samarkand.
From which city did the Mamluk state rule?
Outside the walls of which city did the companion Abu Ayyub al-Ansari die?
He died during the Umayyad siege and was buried near its walls.
Which island was conquered with the first Muslim fleet under Uthman?
Mu'awiyah led the first fleet to Cyprus.
What is the year in which Hasan handed the caliphate to Mu'awiyah and the community reunited called?
The year 41 AH is remembered as the Year of Unity.
What was the administrative office Umar founded to record stipends and revenue?
Umar established the diwan to organise stipends and state income.
Which mosque in Cordoba was later turned into a cathedral?
Abd ar-Rahman I began the Great Mosque, later enlarged.
In which year did the Crusaders capture Jerusalem?
The First Crusade took Jerusalem in 1099.
In which battle were the Seljuks of Rum defeated by the Mongols?
History of the Seljuks of Rum
They lost to the Mongols at Kose Dagh in 1243.
Tughril Beg was its founder and first sultan.
Which Ottoman sultan was called 'the Lawgiver' (Kanuni)?
He was called Kanuni for organising the laws.
He was called Yildirim for his swift movements.
What are the schools of higher learning in the Islamic world called?
Madrasas were the centres of higher education.
Al-Idrisi prepared a world map and geography for Roger II of Sicily.
Which polymath studied India and wrote 'Kitab al-Hind'?
Al-Biruni studied astronomy, mathematics, geography and history.
Which philosopher was called 'the Second Teacher'?
He was called the Second Teacher after Aristotle, the First.
Which Cordoban philosopher is known for his commentaries on Aristotle?
Which structures were established under al-Ma'mun to observe the heavens?
Observatories were built in Baghdad and Damascus.
Which Abbasid caliph supported the House of Wisdom and scholars?
Al-Ma'mun was a great patron of translation and learning.
Which Ottoman ruler took Iznik and opened the first Ottoman madrasa?
Under Orhan, Iznik was taken and the first Ottoman madrasa opened there.
Which Ottoman sultan was martyred at the Battle of Kosovo?
Murad I was killed at Kosovo in 1389.
Between which two rulers was the Battle of Ankara (1402) fought?
Timur defeated Bayezid I at Ankara in 1402.
In which year was Uthman ibn Affan killed?
Uthman was besieged in his house and killed in 656.
In which year was Jerusalem conquered under Umar?
What was the first Muslim city founded by Amr ibn al-As in Egypt?
He founded Fustat and built a mosque there.
What is the period of flourishing science and arts in the Islamic world, roughly 8th to 13th centuries, called?
Science, translation, astronomy and medicine flourished in Baghdad, Cairo and Cordoba.
